note: Adapted from the species-level description in Maiti (Memoirs of the Zoological Survey of India); the original is in English; the alate is recorded in the original as 'Unknown', so there is only a soldier section; the soldier measurements are in Table 21 of the original, and no figures are given in the text.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate unknown. Soldier head pyriform in width, the maximum width almost one and a half times the anterior width; fontanelle rather large; antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 narrowest, shorter than segment 2 and longer than segment 4; postmentum bottle-shaped, the narrowest width almost half the maximum width. The original notes that its soldier resembles that of C. lacteus but that the dorsum of the head lacks undulations.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head straw yellow, sparsely hairy, the rest of the body paler. Head pyriform in width, the maximum width almost one and a half times the anterior width. Fontanelle rather large, fading weakly posteriorly, almost touching the postclypeus. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 narrowest, shorter than segment 2 and longer than segment 4. Labrum long and dome-shaped, the apex transparent and slightly pointed, the apex incurved; two pairs of hairs at the beginning of the transparent part. Postmentum bottle-shaped, the narrowest width almost half the maximum width, at the posterior third. Pronotum far narrower than the head, rather densely hairy, with a broad median concavity, the sides curved outwards, the anterior margin with 4—5 erect hairs, the posterior margin with a shallow median concavity. (Measurements in Table 21 of the original.)
